name: anhedral
description: Scaffold Next.js with Anhedral UI and extend source-owned web/native components.

interface.longDescription: Start with one Next.js app and Anhedral UI. Add source-owned official shadcn or React Native Reusables components through the UI CLI; introduce backend services and extra clients only when needed.
defaultPrompt: Initialize an application with the Anhedral stack, start it locally and open it in my browser.
